subject: [PATCH nfs-utils 5/7] nfsref: flush the export caches with cache_flush()

2026-10-16.patch_summary: This patch updates the nfsref code to use libexport's cache_flush() function instead of writing directly to /proc files. The cache_flush() function uses netlink to flush the export caches when available, and falls back to the /proc files otherwise. This change simplifies the code and improves its reliability by providing a more robust way to flush the cache.
